{{Quote|She and the Human passenger seemed to know each other, but they kept pretty much to themselves.|Lieutenant Rame Cartroll, on Sheel and Gura Tran|<ref name="DA" />}}
'''Sheel''' was a [[Tarasin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Wyrd]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Sheel was sent to meet with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] regarding a plot to discredit the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. She boarded a [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|Confederate corvette]] to conduct the negotiations, but the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was severely damaged in an [[Mission to the Ando system|attack]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] by the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sheel attempted to flee the crippled [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] by hijacking the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]]. However, she was defeated by the operatives and was unsuccessful at escaping.

==Biography==
{{RPG|''[[Decision: Almas]]''}}
Sheel was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tarasin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She served as a member of the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of Tarasin [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and she eventually became a powerful Wyrd adept.<ref name="DA" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[From the Trees]]'' can therefore be dated to around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology''; ''[[Decision: Almas]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Sheel was among a group of Wyrd members<ref name="DA" /> who took up residence at an [[Cloud Mountain Wyrd enclave|enclave]] on the slopes of the dormant Cularin [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] [[Cloud Mountain]] under the command of the Wyrd [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Xinishia]].<ref name="FTT">{{LivingForce|From the Trees}}</ref> She was among several witches that utilized the [[Hand artifact]],<ref name="DA" /> an ancient [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side relic]] that could be used to consume the life forces of victims placed within it to enhance the strength of the artifact's users.<ref name="FTT" /> Whilst operating the Hand artifact, Sheel encountered the [[heroes of Cularin]],<ref name="DA" /> a group of freelance agents who had ventured to Cloud Mountain to free the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chywarra]] from the captivity with the Wyrd.<ref name="FTT" />

Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Sheel traveled to the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]]<ref name="DA" /> in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> to represent the Wyrd at a diplomatic meeting with the [[Thaereian military]] [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] [[Gura Tran]] and representatives of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] government aboard a [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|Confederate CR90 corvette]]. Sheel worked closely with Tran during the meeting, who was secretly a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] with which the Wyrd had close links. During the summit, Sheel and Tran advocated a plan to discredit the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], a leading order of Force users, and the self-government political movement opposing the presence of the Thaereian military in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], by falsely implicating both groups in having dealings with the Confederacy. Though the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the Confederate [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was aware of the purpose of Sheel and Tran's visit to the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], the Wyrd witch and Believer spy kept to themselves and others among the crew including the ship's second-in-command [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rame Cartroll]] had little awareness of who their passengers were and why they were there.<ref name="DA" />

Before Sheel and Tran could conclude their negotiations with the Confederacy, the corvette was [[Mission to the Ando system|bombarded]] by a [[Strike Force Cularin|task force]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a government opposed to the Confederacy. The majority of those on the vessel were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and Sheel was among the few aboard left alive. The attacking Republic forces subsequently dispatched the heroes of Cularin to scour the stricken [[Warship/Legends|warship]] for survivors and to gather intelligence. Sheel determined to escape the corvette and planned to make her way a [[Separatist Ando system base|Confederacy of Independent Systems base]] sited on a nearby [[Unidentified Ando system planetoid|planetoid]], from which she could then make her return to Cularin. Lacking the skills to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] a starship on her own, she attempted to capture one of the heroes of Cularin and thereby force the freelance operatives to fly her to safety in their vessel. However, she was defeated by the agents and was unsuccessful in escaping the crippled corvette.<ref name="DA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Sheel was a militant supporter of the Wyrd's ideology, holding a fanatical dislike of non-Tarasin offworlders on Cularin and of the Jedi. She was committed to assisting the witches in gaining dominance in the Cularin system and regarded the Believers as fitting allies for the Wyrd due to two groups' shared hatred of the Jedi and the Believers' devotion to the dark side. She further considered that the Wyrd could eliminate the Believers once the witches no longer had she need for them. Sheel also believed that supporting the Thaereian military would benefit the Wyrd because she predicted that the Thaereians could bring war and disorder to the Cularin system, conditions under which the Wyrd could rise to power. After becoming stranded on the damaged Confederate corvette in the Ando system, Sheel became bent on escaping from the the ship to return to the Cularin system, though determined to make her death worthwhile if she could not make it off of the vessel.<ref name="DA" />

As a Tarasin, Sheel a frill around her neck and was capable of altering the [[Color/Legends|color]] of her skin. While on her assignment to the Ando system she was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Spear/Legends|spear]] and also carried a [[Force artifact/Legends|dark side talisman]].<ref name="DA" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{RPG|''[[Decision: Almas]]''}}
As a result of her innate abilities as a Tarasin and her capacity for changing her skin color, Sheel was adept at hiding and moving silently. She was also proficient in the use of the Force to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] things, to [[Force speed/Legends|move at speed]], to [[Force healing/Legends|heal herself]], to [[Telekinesis/Legends|grip things]] and to [[Mind trick/Legends|influence]] the minds of others. Sheel could additionally wield the power [[Sense Force|See Force]] and use the Force to [[Tutaminis|dissipate energy]] and strike her enemies with [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]].<ref name="DA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Unfamiliar lizard-lady? Like her. ''"<br />"''Yes. Some sort of frill and her skin kept changing color.|One of the ''Decision: Almas'' player characters and Rame Cartroll, comparing one of the player characters to the Tarasin Wyrd envoy Sheel|<ref name="DA" />}}
Sheel was created by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] and appeared in ''[[Decision: Almas]]'', a [[2004]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying adventure]] set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that served as the first part of the [[Decisions trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] roleplaying campaign. In the adventure, the players roleplay as the freelance agents that Sheel encounters aboard the damaged Confederate corvette. If any of the player characters are Tarasin it is possible for Rame Cartroll to make the freelance agents aware that an envoy of the same species, being Sheel, had visited the wrecked starship. If the players are in the lower or middle [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] experience tiers, Sheel is a novice Wyrd acolyte during her encounter with them, whereas if the players are in the higher or upper tiers she is an experienced Wyrd adept. Players in the higher and upper tiers who also roleplayed the [[2003]] Living Force module ''[[From the Trees]]'' recognize her as one of the Wyrd members operating the Hand artifact<ref name="DA" /> at Cloud Mountain<ref name="FTT" /> that the player characters encounter during the events of that adventure. This is impossible for players of ''Decision: Almas'' in the lower or middle tiers who encounter Sheel as an acolyte because all of the Wyrd members that featured in ''From the Trees'' were experienced Wyrd adepts and not mere novices.<ref name="DA" />

In ''Decision: Almas'', Sheel's encounter with the heroes of Cularin can play out in a number of different ways. She either hides on the starship upon which the player characters traveled to the corvette to await their return or tries to directly capture one of the freelance agents to force into piloting the vessel for her. If the player characters' ship is not directly connected to the damaged Confederate corvette it is possible for Sheel to steal an [[Environment suit/Legends|EVA suit]] and [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] to enable her to access the freelance agents' vessel. When Sheel fights the freelance agents, she continues her attack until she is killed or rendered unconscious. If she is captured by the player characters, Sheel is imprisoned by the Republic task force that assaulted the Confederate warship and kept in isolation until being transferred into the custody of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="DA" />

It is also possible, in the event that the players of ''Decision: Almas'' do not have time for a separate combat encounter with Sheel, that she does not try to get the freelance agents to fly her safety. She instead ambushes the player characters alongside Gura Tran and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Solenoid]] in a separate effort aboard the stricken corvette to steal the freelance agents' ship. The Force powers that Sheel can use vary depending upon the experience tier of the player characters; only if the players are in the middle, higher or upper roleplaying tiers can she use the Force to sense things and only if the players are in the higher or upper tiers can she use the Force to heal herself and dissipate energy. Additionally, only if the player are in the upper tier can she use the Force to move at speed.<ref name="DA" />
